recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body portrait of a person standing in shallow ocean water, featuring a high-contrast color split between deep blue and magenta-tinted water, overlaid with aggressive, distressed, and irregularly scaled typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a horizontal horizon line
Typography layered both in front of and behind the subject's torso
Color gradient transition from cool blue sky to warm magenta surf
Distorted, jagged letterforms contrasting with the fluid water texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full body, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, pale yellow distorted text across the midsection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the large display text, then following the horizontal spread of the lettering across the water's surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive water and sky surrounding the central figure, providing a textured backdrop for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and cobalt blue in the upper two-thirds of the water and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta and hot pink in the foreground surf and lower water.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale acidic yellow for the primary text and bright orange for the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with crushed blacks in the shadows of the clothing and water ripples.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid naturalistic skin tones; use a cool, slightly desaturated palette for the figure.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and blocky sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Jagged, 'torn paper' edges on all strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'glitch' artifacts or missing chunks to simulate physical distress.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured display type paired with a clean, wide-set geometric sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: The pale yellow color of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 'torn' aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the wide, blocky secondary text style common in 90s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a person in oversized 90s denim clothing standing in the ocean. Apply a duotone-like effect where the horizon is deep blue and the foreground water is vibrant magenta. Add heavy film grain and high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, pale yellow, jagged lowercase text across the center, overlapping the subject. Below it, add a smaller line of wide-set orange uppercase sans-serif text. Apply a slight drop shadow to the yellow text.

verificationChecks: Is the water color split between blue and magenta?
Is the main text jagged and irregularly scaled?
Does the text overlap the subject?
Is the overall texture grainy and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the magenta tint in the water
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizon line is straight but the water texture is rough.
Check that the yellow text looks 'cut out' rather than typed.
Verify the high-contrast shadow detail on the subject's clothing.
Confirm the secondary orange text is wide and blocky.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered portrait in a surreal-colored natural environment with 'torn-paper' style distressed typography that breaks the grid and overlaps the subject.
